implemented_chain: Original F3DEX2 VTX header decoding and count/destination validation in RTL
Hardware two-word original-command prefetch after rawLOAD, sharing one sequential AXI read master; no CPU pertriangle feed loop
One controller launches and owns actual baseline raw DMA, transform/light, reciprocal and exact shared-FMA culler
Original TRI1/TRI2 command words decoded in RTL; own-loaded slot and whole64triangle budget validation
Whole-span cull/preflight, retained survivor list and raw view; no output on fallback
Root packet consumer prevalidates all used raw values/list entries and emits ordinary0x56/0x54 commands under backpressure
source_bindings: source-manifest.json; final hardware stream receipt tests/scene-stream-v2/manifest.json

context_contract.matrix: Sixteen initialized words are written while idle; writes are blocked while task owns raw state. Matrix can persist across tasks.
context_contract.scalars: Aspect, lighting coefficients/RGB, lighting enable and UV scales captured at task acceptance. Packet RGB/UV/filter flags captured at packet start.
context_contract.unsupported_features: Captured task-level context descriptor flags. The prototype does not yet extract or classify live SM64 material state; this must not become CPU pertriangle admission.
context_contract.source: Original24-byte vertices and original8-byte command records immutable until matching task completion/repair ACK. Current CRAM pool recycle needs a worker drain or source lease.
context_contract.command_source: Command source is captured once and read in hardware as original8-byte TRI1/TRI2 records. Default native guest window is parameterized and forwarded to both vertex and command DMA; eventual physical PSRAM offset window must be configured explicitly.

ownership.accept: task_valid&&task_ready owns source/context and existing raw bank
ownership.preflight: Every requested command checked before preflight_valid; TRI2 and entire task atomic with respect to output
ownership.success: Packet launch automatically reserves raw/list ports, preventing debug-port theft. Owner ACK is blocked until packet completion and all command reads drain; serial must match.
ownership.fallback: No task packet emitted; in-flight command prefetch is canceled and drained before fallback becomes visible. Source/context/raw retained through matching ordered repair ACK.
ownership.cancel: Cancel wins against first packet launch on the same edge. After accepted packet launch ordinary cancel is ignored and one publication completes; duplicate launch is blocked. Coupled fabric/consumer reset required to discard a published prefix.
ownership.reset: Only coupled fabric reset resets accepted raw AXI state; no async consumer-only reset integration in this prototype.

fallback_reasons.2: unsupported captured context or incomplete matrix
fallback_reasons.5: unsupported command or out-of-range encoded index

existing_reused: Existing raw positions96x32, accumulator128x32, context64x32 and attribute128x32 storage, W queue
Existing raw AXI burst reader: can share at task boundaries with command fetch
Existing CPU/GPU ingress ring and GPU raster/cache
resource_ledger.new_in_current_controller: One128x32 survivor RAM. Command fetch uses two word registers and sequential AXI owner control, no additionalBRAM. Scalar/control registers and converter ALMs remain unfitted; several replace baseline orQGF ownership state.
removed_relative_QGF: Snapshot copier, generation/bank lease metadata and CPU Wfingerprint/importable planes
Competing CPU rawproducer/GPU snapshot reader arbitration
resource_ledger.no_new_FPU_or_DSP: Actual engine has one shared FMA across LOAD and cull; phases sequential. Packet converter adds combinational logic, no BRAM.
not_qualified: 311ALM headroom is tight; controller/command DMA mux/output FIFO/converter fit unproven
Port arithmetic/register counts cannot substitute for final synthesized physical fit

next_integration: Submit immutable coarse task/context descriptors from the real app before any synchronous LOAD, canonical readback or CPU pertriangle admission. Resolve task-level supported material without rescanning triangles.
Preserve exact deferred/cold material preparation and viewport/surface ordering; controlledmaterial packet comparisons do not establish actual raster-state binding.
Implement task-local ordered clipping/equal-W/exception repair or an explicit safe CPU state barrier. Retain raw/source/context until completion/repair and drain vertex-source pool recycle.

Queue credits, real memory contention, GPU/raster scheduling and CPU progress must be exercised by a paired native fullframe replay. Only a useful measured gain justifies area/timing fit; no sweep is proposed.
